test_watermark_detection: test the AudioSeal watermark detection by embedding and detecting a secret message in audio
run_audio_watermarking: run the AudioSeal model to embed a secret message into a WAV audio tensor
detect_watermark_in_audio: detect watermarks in an audio signal using the AudioSeal detector and return detection probabilities
load_pretrained_audioseal: load a pretrained AudioSeal watermarking model using AudioSeal.get_pretrained with the base checkpoint
review_watermark_test: review the TestWatermarkModel test class to understand how AudioSeal watermarking and detection are validated
